entries.title: Job 34:1
segments: ¶Moreover Elihu answered and said,

entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: Hear my words, ye wise [men]; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

entries.title: Job 34:3
segments: For the ear trieth words, as the palate tasteth food.

entries.title: Job 34:4
segments: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us know among ourselves what is good!

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: For Job hath said, I am righteous, and *God hath taken away my judgment:

entries.title: Job 34:6
segments: Should I lie against my right? My wound is incurable without transgression.

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: What man is like Job? he drinketh up scorning like water,

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: And goeth in company with workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

entries.title: Job 34:9
segments: For he hath said, It profiteth not a man if he delight himself in God.

entries.title: Job 34:10
segments: ¶Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be wickedness from *God, and wrong from the Almighty!

entries.title: Job 34:11
segments: For a man's work will he render to him, and cause every one to find according to [his] way.

entries.title: Job 34:12
segments: Yea, surely, *God acteth not wickedly, and the Almighty perverteth not judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments: Who hath entrusted to him the earth? and who hath disposed the whole world?

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments: If he only thought of himself, [and] gathered unto him his spirit and his breath,

entries.title: Job 34:15
segments: All flesh would expire together, and man would return to the dust.

entries.title: Job 34:16
segments: ¶If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: give ear to the voice of my words!

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Should he that hateth right indeed govern? and wilt thou condemn the All-just?

entries.title: Job 34:18
segments: Shall one say to a king, Belial? to nobles, Wicked?

entries.title: Job 34:19
segments: [How then to him] that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich man more than the poor? for they are all the work of his hands.

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments: In a moment they die, even at midnight the people are convulsed and pass away; and the strong are taken away without hand.

entries.title: Job 34:21
segments: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his steps.

entries.title: Job 34:22
segments: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

entries.title: Job 34:23
segments: For he doth not long consider a man, to bring him before *God in judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:24
segments: He breaketh in pieces mighty men without inquiry, and setteth others in their stead;

entries.title: Job 34:25
segments: Since he knoweth their actions; and he overthroweth [them] in the night, and they are crushed.

entries.title: Job 34:26
segments: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others,

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: Because they have turned back from him, and would consider none of his ways;

entries.title: Job 34:28
segments: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 34:29
segments: When he giveth quietness, who then will disturb? and when he hideth [his] face, who shall behold him? and this towards a nation, or towards a man alike;

entries.title: Job 34:30
segments: That the ungodly man reign not, that the people be not ensnared.

entries.title: Job 34:31
segments: ¶For hath he said unto *God, I bear [chastisement], I will not offend;

entries.title: Job 34:32
segments: What I see not, teach thou me; if I have done wrong, I will do so no more?

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments: Shall he recompense according to thy mind? for thou hast refused [his judgment]; for thou so choosest, and not I; speak then what thou knowest.

entries.title: Job 34:34
segments: Men of understanding will say to me, and a wise man who heareth me:

entries.title: Job 34:35
segments: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were not with intelligence.

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: Would that Job may be tried unto the end, because of [his] answers after the manner of evil men!

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth [his hands] among us, and multiplieth his words against *God.
